name: Local portfolio
description: Your holdings from a file on your Mac, valued at Yahoo Finance's latest prices. An example of a local-data adapter: it reads one file, through one declared sandbox exception.

tools.name: get_portfolio
tools.title: Get portfolio
tools.description: Your holdings from ~/Documents/Valet/portfolio.csv (lines of symbol,quantity), each with its latest price, currency and value. Prices are delayed as the exchange requires.

exceptions.purpose: Your holdings: one line per symbol, with the quantity you hold.
